description.p: STM32CubeProgrammer is the all-in-one tool for programming and configuring STM32 microcontrollers and microprocessors, through the ST-LINK debug probe (JTAG and SWD) as well as the bootloader interfaces (UART, USB DFU, I2C, SPI, and CAN).

ul.li: Reading, writing, and verifying device memory, with support for hex, binary, ELF, and S-record files
Option byte, OTP, and core register programming
Programming of external flash memories through flash loaders
Secure firmware install (SFI/SFIx), firmware signing, and key provisioning through STM32 Trusted Package Creator
Serial Wire Viewer, register viewer, and hard fault analyzer
Script manager and command line interfaces for automated programming

description.p: STM32CubeProgrammer 是烧录与配置 STM32 微控制器与微处理器的一体化工具，可通过 ST-LINK 调试探头（JTAG 与 SWD）以及 bootloader 接口（UART、USB DFU、I2C、SPI、CAN）连接器件。

ul.li: 读写与校验器件内存，支持 hex、binary、ELF 与 S-record 文件
Option bytes、OTP 与内核寄存器编程
通过 flash loader 烧录外部闪存
借助 STM32 Trusted Package Creator 完成安全固件安装（SFI/SFIx）、固件签名与密钥配置
Serial Wire Viewer、寄存器查看器与 Hard Fault 分析器
提供脚本管理器与命令行接口，便于自动化烧录
